areas.finding: The Atlas Ice Lynx retains the stocky pale-gray spotted feline body, black ear tufts, broad snarling face, pale cheek ruff and brown raised shoulder crest. No armor, icicle spikes or companion harness is introduced.
The four cardinal and two oblique views are distinct, labeled and fully framed with ears, paws and bobtail visible.
Four thick feline limbs and broad clawed paws resolve in profiles and obliques. The stance is grounded and natural overlap does not create missing or duplicated limbs.
Both pointed ears have dark terminal tufts. The muzzle, white cheek ruff, brow accents and one open jaw remain coherent in all facial views.
One very short upright bobtail with a pale tip originates at the rump and remains short in left, right, rear and rear-oblique views; no long leopard tail appears.
Major gray spotted coat zones, lighter underside, cheek patches and brown shoulder crest are stable across the views. Fine spot boundaries remain illustrative rather than a proven shared UV texture.
Rounded powerful body forms, controlled grouped fur, clear expression, clean margins and studio shadows form a coherent Havenline hostile-animal reference.

source_interpretation_limit: The small original Atlas source fixes visible identity. Hidden reverse anatomy and fine surface construction are authored static-reference interpretation. This approval establishes no native mesh, rig, animation, use state or gameplay behavior.
minor_polish_limit: Individual fine spot contours and fur tufts vary slightly between illustrated angles; the large-scale markings and body structure stay coherent. Native texture continuity is a separate future check.
